title: A Fast and Accurate Fourier Neural Operator-Based Surrogate for Melt-Pool Prediction in Laser Processing
abstract: arXiv:2602.06241v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: High-fidelity simulations of laser welding capture complex thermo-fluid phenomena, including phase change, free-surface deformation, and keyhole dynamics, but their computational cost limits large-scale process exploration and real-time use. We present the Laser Processing Fourier Neural Operator (LP-FNO), a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO)-based surrogate model that learns the parametric solution operator of laser processing from multiphysics simulations generated with FLOW-3D WELD. Through a reformulation of the transient problem in a reference frame moving with the laser and the application of temporal averaging, the system is recast into a quasi-steady setting suitable for operator learning, even in the stable keyhole welding regime. translated_title: 激光加工中熔池预测的快速精确傅里叶神经算子代理模型
translated_abstract: 激光焊接的高保真模拟能够捕捉复杂的热流体现象，包括相变、自由表面变形和匙孔动力学，但其高昂的计算成本限制了大规模工艺探索和实时应用。我们提出了激光加工傅里叶神经算子（LP-FNO），这是一种基于傅里叶神经算子的代理模型，通过FLOW-3D WELD生成的多物理场仿真来学习激光加工的参数化解算子。通过将瞬态问题在随激光移动的参考系中重新表述，并应用时间平均，该系统被转化为适合算子学习的准稳态设置，即使在稳定的匙孔焊接区间也同样适用。LP-FNO在覆盖传导模式与匙孔模式的宽工艺窗口内，将工艺参数映射为三维温度场和熔池边界，并采用归一化焓公式
tldr: 该论文提出LP-FNO代理模型，通过将瞬态问题在随激光移动的参考系中重构并施加时间平均，将其转化为适合算子学习的准稳态问题，从而快速精确地从工艺参数预测激光加工中的三维温度场与熔池边界，覆盖从传导焊到匙孔焊的宽工艺窗口。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes LP-FNO, a fast and accurate Fourier Neural Operator surrogate that recasts the transient laser processing problem into a quasi-steady setting via a laser-moving reference frame and temporal averaging, enabling rapid and precise prediction of 3D temperature fields and melt-pool boundaries from process parameters across both conduction and keyhole welding regimes.
